Name: replace your cat with niko from oneshot crossover mod(wip)
Author: torinsan1
Description:
currently this is just a sprite change but in the future as I learn more about modding I hope to add unique behaviors to Niko's AI (like eating pancakes if you place them on the table) and a cut scene for when you first install the mod


to install you need to find the location at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals then take the cat.xnb folder and replace it with the folder of the same name you downloaded from this page


I imagine some people are going to be wondering why I changed the way Niko looked so much well its mainly because when I placed Niko's sprite next to Jas and Vincent Niko seemed out of place so I decided to redraw Niko from scatch and this is what I got. I still think I'm gonna tweek it in the future but for now it will work

niko is a character from oneshot(game)
oneshot is made by nightmargin
